nodes.label: Silly Goosing Screenshot
nodes.description: Win95-style desktop screenshot showing the GooseOS voting carousel window titled 'ballot-lottery.exe'. Displays a full-screen photograph of a white goose with wings spread wide, standing on grass near a body of water with trees in the background. Below the image is a caption in monospace/pixel font reading: 'the tribe stood at a crossroads, each faction drawn down a path: one bred and eager for war, the other, hellbent on "silly-goosing"'. Left and right chevron navigation arrows flank the image for carousel navigation. A Win95-style taskbar is visible at the bottom with a Start button.
nodes.caption_text: the tribe stood at a crossroads, each faction drawn down a path: one bred and eager for war, the other, hellbent on "silly-goosing"

nodes.label: Goose Art Voting Carousel
nodes.description: The voting carousel UI component as shown in the screenshot — a windowed viewer (ballot-lottery.exe) that presents uploaded goose art images one at a time with left/right navigation arrows and a humorous caption below each image. Part of the goose art upload/voting feature of GooseOS.

nodes.label: ballot-lottery.exe Window
nodes.description: A Win95-style application window titled 'ballot-lottery.exe' containing the goose art voting carousel. Has standard Win95 title bar with minimize/maximize/close controls visible at top right.

nodes.label: Silly-Goosing Narrative Caption
nodes.description: Humorous narrative caption displayed beneath the goose photo in the voting carousel: 'the tribe stood at a crossroads, each faction drawn down a path: one bred and eager for war, the other, hellbent on "silly-goosing"'. Establishes the playful/silly lore of GooseOS and directly explains the 'silly-goosing' concept referenced in the filename.
nodes.text_content: the tribe stood at a crossroads, each faction drawn down a path: one bred and eager for war, the other, hellbent on "silly-goosing"

nodes.label: White Goose Wings Spread Photo
nodes.description: The goose art image displayed in the carousel: a photograph of a white goose with both wings fully spread, standing on green grass near a pond or river, with trees visible in the background. The goose is centered and facing the camera in a dramatic, silly-goosing pose.
nodes.subject: white goose
nodes.setting: outdoor grass near water with trees

nodes.label: Win95-Style Taskbar
nodes.description: The Win95-style taskbar visible at the bottom of the GooseOS desktop in this screenshot. Shows a Start button on the left, consistent with the windowing system implemented in window-manager.js.
